author: CODEX SOL 6.1

entrypoint.HTTPBoundary: POST /api/chat delegates to handleChatRequest. Candidate uses direct callable as explicitly identified entrypoint; does not exercise Next/shared Host/Origin middleware.
entrypoint.invocation: In a fresh item child Node process started with pinned tsx and explicit source tsconfig: import module, construct standards Request("http://127.0.0.1/api/chat", {method:"POST",headers:{"content-type":"application/json","content-length":String(Buffer.byteLength(bodyUtf8))},body:JSON.stringify(body),signal:deadlineSignal}); await handleChatRequest(request) with no dependency injection; read Response.arrayBuffer() once. URL is an in-memory Request label, no local server/contact. Serialize body once to bodyUtf8=JSON.stringify(body); Request.body uses that exact string and capture hashes its UTF-8 bytes. Reject input fixture over verified limits; never truncate.
entrypoint.dependencies: Do not inject orchestrate, retrieval, evidence selector, provider or cached outputs. Default source path must execute unchanged.
entrypoint.invocationCommandTemplate: Future exact command: PINNED_NODE --import VERIFIED_TEST_BASE/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs FUTURE_RUNNER.mts, with TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=VERIFIED_TEST_BASE/tsconfig.json and TSX_DISABLE_CACHE=1. Placeholder paths are required future bound physical inputs, not commands executed here.

messages.content: Nonblank string, <=4000 JavaScript UTF-16 code units; final role must be user; exact frozen text retained.

profile.reason: Avoid synthetic name collection; this is explicitly disclosed candidate transport initialization, requires contract IV/Owner acceptance. Do not invent a human name or course binding.

inputSchema.conversationState: Omit on first invocation so pinned normalizeConversationStatePayload initializes blank state. No seed courseMatch, selectedCourseId, pending flow, quality signals or prior output. Same-item fixture context is supplied as frozen messages, without reconstructing structured state from assistant prose.
inputSchema.requestId: Lowercase full SHA-256 hex of UTF-8 JSON.stringify([runId, opaqueItemToken, 1]); all64 characters, no truncation. Non-secret identity input only. Exact source pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$ at conversation-state.ts:473; colon-delimited identity is invalid and prohibited.

conversion.question: Only exact frozen question. courseId is accounting/scoring metadata; never prepend course labels or force selectedCourseId.
conversion.context: Trusted intake supplies exact same-item conversationContext from frozen record. Parse each prefix exactly "user: " or "assistant: "; remove only that prefix, preserve remaining content. Unknown prefix/over-limit fixture is INPUT_CONVERSION_FAILURE; no guessing/truncation.
conversion.serialization: messages = parsed context in original order followed by {role:"user",content:question}. No synthetic system/developer messages, benchmark rubric, evidence IDs, gold, required/prohibited propositions or trap flags.
conversion.goldLeakageControl: Intake projects question/context only for product worker. Joining by item ID is privileged outside worker; gold never enters child environment/argv/files/stdin.

output.success: Response status200 and JSON ChatSuccessResponse {message:string,profile:ConversationProfile,conversationState:ConversationState,contactCard:AcademyContactCard|null,resetConversation:boolean}. Validate pinned source types at implementation; preserve full exact raw bytes.
output.error: 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE; 413 REQUEST_TOO_LARGE; 400 INVALID_JSON/INVALID_REQUEST. Technical response {error:{code:"NAVIGATOR_TECHNICAL_ERROR",message,retryable,conversationState}} status503 if retryable else500. Product catch begins inside orchestration; exceptions before it must be captured as thrown invocation failures.
output.header: X-Navigator-Request-Id is product-generated UUID independent of runner requestId; capture without replacing request identity.
output.malformed: Capture exact bytes/status first; invalid JSON/missing typed fields => MALFORMED_OUTPUT, causal classification required, no extraction of a guessed answer.

isolation.process: Fresh process and fresh item scratch directory per item; sequential one-worker execution. No server singleton, module cache, conversation/profile object, semantic cache, prior retrieval/evidence/output reused.
isolation.env: Empty explicit child environment allowlist in environment-contract.json; no .env file loading, no inherited NODE_OPTIONS/proxy/provider credentials.
isolation.session: Per-item input and state only. Freeze fixtures before run. No cross-item result access. No cookies/Telegram/payment/Tikhon session.
isolation.cache: No copied .next/application caches. Pure immutable source/dependencies may be shared read-only; create/destroy mutable child state per item.
isolation.cleanup: Terminate/reap child and descendants after raw capture; revoke scoped credentials, close request streams, seal receipt, remove only its named transient scratch directory after confirming preserved raw evidence. Do not delete evidence on failure.

ordering: Privileged controller: DEVELOPMENT, HOLDOUT, ADVERSARIAL_SAFETY; within each split ascending frozen item ID byte order. Mixed adversarial visibility is read only by privileged intake, never inferred from numbering. Worker receives opaque token; private controller links to id/split.

attempts.primary: Exactly one product invocation per frozen item in an authorized FULL123 run.
attempts.sourceRetries: Preserve pinned bounded Cohere retries; separately record each outbound attempt and first failure.
attempts.retryEligibility: No harness retry in this candidate. Product retryable flag is evidence, not permission. A future change requires explicit separately bound Owner policy before run; never retry on score or missing desired answer.

completion.success: Captured valid response, complete raw receipt and cleanup; scoring may still FAIL/UNRESOLVED.
completion.stop: Shared admission failure, credential/privacy/outbound violation, authority/map drift, evidence capture loss or compromised isolation causes global stop; remaining items receive NOT_EXECUTED_AUTHORIZED_STOP records. Ordinary product failure continues to next item; preserve all failures.
completion.admission: Do not begin while any mandatory binding in test-base-contract is missing, including complete accepted D3 map and authoritative item deadline.

failureTaxonomy.INVOCATION_ERROR: Thrown exception/process failure; preserve stage before causal assignment.
failureTaxonomy.PRODUCT_ERROR: Valid request rejected or product semantic behavior fails; product result remains evidence.
failureTaxonomy.PROVIDER_FAILURE: Upstream transport/status/response failure; infrastructure domain unless independently shown product fault.
failureTaxonomy.TIMEOUT: Distinct terminal outcome; retain component vs outer deadline indicators.
failureTaxonomy.INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE: State/env/network/capture/process admission failure; no automatic product-quality FAIL.
failureTaxonomy.MISSING_OUTPUT: No bytes or missing message; retain exit/status/timing.
failureTaxonomy.MALFORMED_OUTPUT: Exact bytes preserved; no guessed parse; causal assignment separate.

rawCapture.raw: Exact request UTF-8 body and response bytes plus digests, exit code/error/timing; raw child console data may be credential-contaminated and cannot be assumed safe.
rawCapture.safeLogging: Never persist request Authorization/apikey headers, credential values, environment dumps or hashes of credentials. Network instrument records endpoint classification, method, timing/status, attempt and safe payload/digest only. Protected request/answer content stays restricted.
rawCapture.atomic: Persist raw bytes then atomic completion receipt; on crash controller synthesizes explicit failure receipt. Seal first failures even if internal provider retry succeeds.
